create.name: Karina Schelde
create.bio:
Karina Schelde is a Danish-born voice and sound teacher who founded Soul Voice, a method of working with the unrestrained human voice as a path to self-expression and spiritual growth. She worked in Denmark in the 1980s as an actress and stage director, and her training also spans bodywork, counselling, breathwork and shamanic practice. Her first book, The Magic Power in the Human Voice, came out in Hawaii in 1988; she has since written Soul Voice, translated into several languages, and Expression into Freedom, both published in New Zealand.

In Soul Voice workshops, people use sounding, breath, movement and ritual to explore the voice as an expression of the soul and to let go of habits that hold it back, working in groups and in nature as well as indoors. She has taught the method in more than twenty-five countries, from introductory weekends and week-long residential immersions to multi-year programmes that certify practitioners and teachers, and she leads seminars in France, Germany, Spain, Italy, New Zealand and Australia. She also gives private sessions, leads group sound concerts and meditations, and has made instructional videos so that people can practise at home.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link.

Health framing on her pages: her Meet page says Soul Voice reduces stress, clears trauma and influences the immune, hormone and digestive systems, and soulvoice.net runs 'scientific research' on its healing efficacy. Items here are described without those claims, but owner may judge the method too therapy-led.
No public base on her sites; city and country left empty.
soulvoice.net (the method's site she founded) used alongside karinaschelde.com; its general inboxes connect@ and admin@soulvoice.net not used.
Montpellier workshop: no price on her agenda; the page lists a local organiser's email for bookings. The agenda page is used as its URL (no separate event page).
Videos are short presentations from her own channel; several are the same clip with subtitles in other languages, only the English versions used.
New-age language such as 'telepathic sound healing to the elements'; not conspiracy content.
left_out: Books Soul Voice, Expression into Freedom (with audio CD) and The Magic Power in the Human Voice (out of print): no ISBN on her own pages.
PCP Practitioners' Certification Program: the current cycle began in December 2025 (multi-year, already started); framed as training therapists.
TTP Teacher Training Programme and Advanced Supervision: modules of programmes already under way.
Personalised retreat topics 'Pain-Release Work' and 'Healing Through Sound Frequencies to Access… Cellular Memory': not included in the description (health framing).
CDs (Chakra Sound Healing & Heart Songs, Deep Soul Meditation & Rainbow Relaxation, The Song of the Soul): music/audio products.
Copies of the same video with Japanese, Danish, Spanish, Italian, German, French, Dutch and Portuguese subtitles; 1.5-hour concert recording.
